scope: Active source-built Chapter V and VI traditional, standalone visual, and formal companion TeX entrypoints/bodies/wrappers listed in v_vi_scope.json. Historical variants, code, archives and figures excluded.
word_count_note: Whitespace-delimited TeX tokens include math, code and duplicate plate bodies. This is a reproducible source scope, not an English word count.
coverage_method: Targeted contextual rhythm pass: all unmasked semicolon candidate lines were read, all 112 dash candidate lines were screened in context, and the complete hyphen-token inventory was screened, with optional or potentially formulaic modifiers read in their sentences. Formulaic-phrase searches and the prior full prose review supplied adjacent context. Every changed sentence was reread. This is not a new continuous sentence-by-sentence grammar audit of all 96k raw TeX tokens.
candidate_count_note: Masked lexical candidates exclude inline/display math, literal commands/environments, comments and TikZ bodies, but still include technical labels, source-layout text and some dense table entries. Retained counts include these contextual exclusions and repeated canonical plate copies. They are not counts of independent editorial problems.
